name: stillport
description: Find, preview, and export photos with the local Stillport CLI.

interface.longDescription: Find, inspect, preview, and export photos from Apple Photos, Google Photos Picker, or an extracted Google Takeout archive. This skill uses the Stillport CLI in a local macOS, Windows or Linux shell environment; it includes a checksum-verifying installer and a public synthetic fixture for setup checks. Apple Photos requires macOS Automation permission. Google Photos requires your own OAuth Desktop client and a person to select items in Picker; it cannot search your entire Google library unattended. Takeout searches local filenames, captions, dates, and folders. Photos remain with their providers or on your computer until you request an export or share them through your agent host. Cloud and mobile chats without a suitable local shell cannot access your photo library. The plugin does not bundle a hosted MCP connection.
defaultPrompt: Help me set up Stillport and test it with the included public photo fixture.
Find photos in Apple Photos and make previews of the best matches.
Search my local Google Takeout archive and export the photos I choose.

publication.release_notes: Windows x64 and ARM64 binaries and installer, private offline galleries, archive index recovery, Unicode metadata search, and stricter preview validation in CLI 0.2.0.
